AI dispatch board, route optimisation, technician app (24h offline), GPS tracking, field evidence & payments.
Bench repair L1/L2/L3, serial genealogy, burn-in testing, workshop costing and knowledge capture.
Multi-leg consignments, unbroken chain of custody, POD with OTP, rider app, courier partners, COD.
Counter operations at 51+ centres — token queue, device custody, cash drawer, shift close, counter sales.
Managed IT services — remote sessions, monitored estate, alert-to-ticket, runbooks, patching, SLA credits.
Data recovery case management, sealed media custody, secure destruction with certificates, backup plans.
Single golden record for every party — roles, hierarchies, OTP verification, consent, segments, credit.
Leads, opportunities, corporate account plans, QBRs, renewals T-90, cross-sell and win/loss.
Privilege tiers, points ledger, wallet, vouchers, referral programme, alliance benefits, liability.
CSAT/NPS/CES surveys, closed feedback loop, complaint SLA & escalation, goodwill authority, VoC analytics.
Unified voice + digital conversations, skills routing, agent desktop with Customer-360 pop, notifications for the ERP.
Bengali-first assistant — intent recognition, RAG on live ERP data, authenticated actions, human handoff.
Segment-driven journeys, offer selection, A/B & attribution, seasonal templates, co-marketing with partners.
Everything sellable — unified item master, rBOM, standard repair time, fault taxonomy, 14 contract families.
Price engine (item×customer×channel×date), labour rate cards, brand reimbursement rates, discount governance.
Estimate build-up to customer quotation, multi-channel approval loop, e-signature, tender & competitive bids.
14 contract families — entitlement definition/consumption, PM schedules, SLA credits, amendments, renewals.
Warranty register, entitlement "who pays", brand claims with auto evidence packs, recalls, protection plans.
Zuora-class billing — schedules, usage rating, proration, dunning, MRR/ARR/churn/NRR metrics.
Online storefront — compatibility filtering, mixed carts, service booking as commerce, bKash/Nagad/card checkout.
Freelance engineer / shop ecosystem — KYC, listings, job broadcast & bidding, commission, wallets, disputes.
Brand partnerships (17+), alliances, referral partners, deal registration, resellers, franchise management.
8 asset categories — fleet register, availability, agreements & deposits, damage recovery, utilisation.
Automated valuation, provenance screening, refurb work orders, A-D grading, harvest-to-parts, resale.
Collection network, triage & disposition, certified partners, statutory DoE/BTRC returns, impact reporting.
Stock ledger across 6 ownership classes — serial/lot trace, van stock, valuation, transfers, counts.
Physical execution — bins & slots, directed put-away, wave picking, packing, RF mobile, task interleaving.
Demand-to-PO, RFQ with normalised comparison, three-way match, blanket orders, expediting, spend analysis.
Supplier qualification gate, scorecards, corrective actions, risk assessment, compliance screening.
Forecast orchestration with MAPE tracking, safety stock, reorder policies, multi-echelon rebalancing.
LC/TT lifecycle, HS classification, ASYCUDA Bill of Entry, duty cascade, landed-cost allocation.
Permanent identity per device — multi-identifier model, custody chain, service history, parts genealogy, estates.
Test instruments & tools — calibration management, tool crib issue/return, fitness states, usage per job.
Vans & bikes — statutory documents with expiry control, fuel efficiency, telematics, cost per km.
51+ sites — lease administration, statutory licences, utilities, branch infrastructure, safety equipment.
TimescaleDB hypertables, threshold alerting, asset health scoring, failure prediction, prescriptive routing.
Chart of accounts, 7-dimension model, subledger posting engine, July–June close, statutory statements.
Billable events from every module, Mushak 6.3 invoices, bKash/Nagad/card receipts, dunning, ageing.
Vendor invoices with 3-way match, TDS/VDS at source, employee expenses & advances, payment runs.
Bank reconciliation, branch cash consolidation, rider COD, gateway/MFS settlement, BEFTN/RTGS execution.
VAT 15%, Mushak 6.1–9.1 registers & returns, TDS/VDS, challans, NID capture, statutory calendar.
Performance obligations, contract balances, commission ledger, seller/partner payouts, clawbacks, escrow.
Capex requests to retirement — CWIP, dual-book depreciation (accounting + tax Third Schedule), verification.
Allocation cycles, job & contract costing, 14-stream business-line profitability, branch league, budgets.
Hire-to-retire, Labour Act documents (appointment letter, ID card, service book), org structure, ESS/MSS.
Biometric + geofenced mobile capture, moon-dependent holidays, rosters, availability published to dispatch.
BD gross-to-net engine, tax slabs AY26-27, PF, gratuity ≥30 days/yr, festival bonus, BEFTN bank files.
Goal cascades, KPI attribution to payroll, technician incentive schemes, calibration, recognition.
Competency framework, brand certification register with expiry, hard block on expired certification at dispatch.
Requisitions vs budget, structured interviews, practical technician assessments, pre-boarding, PDPA erasure.
Hazard register, lone-worker safety, battery/electrical hazards, statutory accident clock, safety committee.
ISO 9001:2015 operating system — process register, NCRs, CAPA with verification, audits, management review.
Enterprise risk register, internal control testing, SoD rules, licence register, PDPA governance, whistleblowing.
Auto-filing from transactions, bilingual OCR search, e-signature envelopes, retention 5–10y, evidence packs.
Repair procedures & fault→fix, troubleshooting trees, offline distribution to technician app, brand bulletins.
Role dashboards, standard report library, embedded analytics, scheduled bursting, spreadsheet retirement.
Dispatch scoring 70% auto-assign, fault classification from Bengali text, demand MAPE<22%, trade-in valuation.
Medallion lakehouse, dimensional model, semantic metric registry (one certified number), lineage, masking.
Workflow engine with approval chains, DoA matrix, business-rule repository, unified task inbox, escalation.
API gateway, 47 external connectors (bKash/Nagad/SSLCOMMERZ/Google Maps/Traccar), event bus, offline sync.
MFA everywhere, 6 data-isolation tiers T0–T5, field-level permissions, SoD enforcement, immutable audit.
Legal entities, 51+ branch register with <1-day provisioning, config registry, feature flags, health console.
Domain ownership, stewardship workflow as only change path, DQ rule engine, golden-record survivorship.
Country packs, bn-BD ICU collation & phonetic input, lakh/crore grouping, residency rules, expansion gateways.
Employee service catalogue, incidents & changes, IT asset lifecycle, licence optimisation, CMDB.
Branch openings, rollouts, bulk decommissions — WBS, earned value, milestone billing, portfolio stage gates.

journeys.en: Customer books an on-site repair (P01 → payment)

steps.what: Customer opens app / portal, Bengali UI, picks device + symptom
Identity via OTP — golden record matched or created
Service resolved with upfront price + slot (≤3 steps)
AI scores candidates → assigned → ETA published to customer
Job accepted, navigation, photos w/ GPS, fix, e-sign
Quality checkpoint gate → repair warranty issued
Token issued, fast intake, device condition photos
L1/L2/L3 routing; parts from branch store
Serial-tracked consumption; consignment hard block respected
Payment captured at counter, drawer reconciled at shift close
Customer books pick & drop with slot
Multi-leg journey planned; seal number issued
Scan + OTP + photos at every custody handover
Repair executed under custody state ON BENCH
Delivery leg with OTP + signature + COD if due
Rider COD reconciled at end of shift
Warranty order — entitlement says brand pays
Auto-created on delivery; evidence pack assembled <5 min
Photos, diagnostics, parts genealogy, certification proof

journeys.en: Corporate AMC: contract → PM schedule → consolidated invoice

steps.what: Requisition approved; RFQ to qualified suppliers
Payment run with TDS at source
Work order, QA incl. battery health
Listing live on storefront with disclosure report
Job broadcast to matching sellers → bidding
Execution QC identical to in-house standards
Case with specialism routing; media sealed
